public_schema.joint_position: encoder q, rad (mobile base translation m if present)
public_schema.joint_velocity: encoder qdot, rad/s (mobile base m/s if present)
public_schema.tcp_twist: world spatial velocity, m/s then rad/s
public_schema.measured_wrench: on tool at TCP, world N then Nm
public_schema.previous_action: previous issued shared skill after public rate limit, BEFORE hidden actuator delay
public_schema.elapsed_seconds: time since task reset; preparation charged separately
public_schema.body_position: measured world xyz, zero for a fixed base
public_schema.controller_feedback: WBC residual and base tilt; zero for fixed base

shared_memory.clock: each observed20ms tick; T3 phase update every10ticks
shared_memory.phase_geometry: known upper_clearance/side waypoints for T1; measured contact and known keyway for T3

actions.acp: native19D REF9/VT9/positive scalar stiffness; original anisotropic SPD controller
actions.force_off: source gap half-minimum-positive threshold is available to every method; continuous positive forces retained
actions.chunks: native method horizon; causal memory observes every executed control tick

evaluation.terminal: unchanged scene deadline, geometric tolerances, force constraints and hold duration in physical_configs
evaluation.dense_shaping: training only; excluded from paper cost
evaluation.replay: every qualification episode; physics calls charged separately
evaluation.mode: independently classified physical trace must match requested mode

deferred: UR5e until separate scene/source-to-target cell qualification

permissions.A_fixed: same charged short probe buffer; no complete target task training, target reward or successful target demonstrations; updates query only calibrated twin
permissions.A_active: method chooses short probes under the same count/duration/validation budget; report separately from shared-buffer ablations
permissions.B_log: same predeclared target logs and total executed transitions for every method; no target reward/model selection
permissions.B_online: same charged target task duration with reward; no extra expert demonstrations
permissions.C_supervised: same predeclared charged target calibration and validation episodes per method; no final-test selection

A_fixed.held_out_physical_validation: included in the stated probe count; no free replacements or target full-task tuning

C_supervised.validation: one complete demonstration per mode reserved within each total;2-demo point is validation-only, no supervised fit

development_budgets.accounting: reset/preparation, failures, interrupted transitions, all real validation and exact replay separately reported and never rolled back
development_budgets.test: future sealed final-test cohort; these P3 development scenes/seeds never become independent final test
development_budgets.source_training: all pretraining, checkpoints, source physics and tuning attempts disclosed; source development is not target-data budget

admission.scope: per task/method/permission; development only, not final paper ranking
admission.source_gate: 4 fresh complete episodes, both modes twice;4/4 independent success and exact replay; no status mismatch
admission.scene_gate: public expert reaches both modes of the named development cell; exact charged replay
admission.method_gate: frozen checkpoint SHA, bound chart, batch1/4, continuation, evaluator/accounting checks
admission.paper_gate: separate preregistered equal target budgets, independent final seeds, uncertainty and complete baseline training
